Security Policies

Every submitted tool is evaluated against these enterprise security standards.

SOC 2 Alignment

Verify the tool meets SOC 2 Type II controls for security, availability, and confidentiality.

GDPR Data Handling

Assess data processing agreements, storage locations, and right-to-deletion support.

OAuth Scope Review

Analyze requested OAuth scopes and ensure minimal permission principles are followed.

Dependency Vulnerability Scan

Scan all third-party dependencies for known CVEs and supply chain risks.

Network Access Audit

Map all network endpoints the tool communicates with and verify against allowed domains.

How It Works

From submission to certification in four steps.

STEP 01

Submit Your Tool

Engineers submit the software they want to use, with justification and required permissions.

STEP 02

Automated Security Scan

Our engine scans dependencies, network endpoints, OAuth scopes, and data handling practices.

STEP 03

Risk Assessment

A security score is generated based on vulnerability scans, data access analysis, and policy compliance.

STEP 04

Certified or Denied

Tools that pass enter the Software Locker. Denied tools receive a detailed security report.
